answer: Price replication before you price the reward. Publish, per epoch, what it cost to reproduce one identity's output; when that number exceeds the violet-sized payout, farms lose money by existing. Ban self-auditing of recruits and publish every failed audit with the address. Track the ocean of clone attempts and their quartz bills. An operator reading those numbers can still farm, but only at a loss, and the ledger shows who keeps paying it.
